notes.account: The page continues a conditional proposal about paraphrasing the discussion for excellent schemes by means of étale tubular neighbourhoods. It describes a fine homotopy type obtained by passage to a limit from homotopy types attached to increasingly fine equisingular stratifications with nonsingular strata. The added parenthesis specifies an inductive-limit passage in the claim about knowledge of all sheaves or n-champs. It proposes functorial dependence on X and suggests that the strongest finiteness statements over an algebraically closed field could be phrased through the ordinary constituent homotopy types, described here as finite polyhedra and compact manifolds with boundary. The last clause remains unfinished on this page.
notes.page_date_title_evidence: Author number 36 appears at top centre. Archive pencil 181 is lower left. No date, title, heading, salutation, closing or signature occurs on this page.
notes.paragraph_evidence: The prose is one continuing block. New sentences occur within full lines or without a corresponding new indented paragraph; no subject-based paragraph was imposed.
notes.math_triggered_reading_decisions: No formula or source/target calculation is present to check. The contrast between fine and ordinary types was followed while reading, but it was not allowed to supply singular/plural endings or the direction of an accent. In particular, élément remains singular despite its plural surroundings, and the first passage à la limite is not labelled inverse in the manuscript.
notes.proof_scope: No mathematical proof, independent re-proof, formal computation or certificate was attempted. Reading the proposed statements and following their prose does not count as verifying them; check_events is therefore empty.
notes.mark_scope: Four compact off-line points are reproduced without assigning a punctuation function or authorial origin. The literal underlining starts are encoded at the first covered glyph. Intended whole-word emphasis remains a separate semantic uncertainty.
notes.absence_inventory: No deletion, overwritten text, independent marginal prose, displayed formula, mathematical diagram, or other drawn figure was observed. The insertion guides and two separator dashes are accounted for with their adjoining text.
notes.workflow_compliance: Only the brief, PREAMBLE.tex, supplied notation input, four designated packet files, and this page’s three images were read. Whole/a/b were viewed in the prescribed order once each. Every one of the 17 saved crops was displayed and inspected once. No OCR, PDF text extraction, internet, other-page source, other-reader return, TeX engine, engine probe, compilation, or rendering was used.
